techParks.name: Bagmane World Technology Center
techParks.description: Bagmane's 52-acre SEZ campus on the Outer Ring Road at Mahadevapura, launched 2007, with gem-named blocks (Amber, Citrine, Coral, Garnet, Opal, Aquamarine) and the Goldstone tower; the Bagmane REIT deck lists it at 4.5 msf with ~98% committed occupancy. Samsung's 4 lakh sq ft Goldstone lease (2019, renewed 2024) is the best-documented tenancy; Ericsson, Dell EMC, Visa and AB InBev's GCC are mapped on its blocks.

techParks.name: Bagmane Constellation Business Park
techParks.description: 30-acre, 5.3 msf park at Doddanekundi Circle on the ORR, launched 2007, with eight buildings named after constellations: Phoenix (Samsung), Virgo (Qualcomm), Carina (Red Hat), Orion (Boeing, Nvidia), Taurus 1-4 (Amazon in Taurus 3, Arm in Taurus 4 North Tower) and Aquila (Amazon). Fully committed per the Bagmane REIT.

techParks.name: Bagmane Capital
techParks.locality: Doddanekundi, Outer Ring Road (north of Doddanekundi Circle)
techParks.description: 42-acre campus launched 2017 (5.5 msf completed, 1.5 msf under construction, 10.5 msf planned) anchored by a central park, with towers Luxor N/S, Kyoto E/W (Google, 8.7 lakh sq ft), Rome N/S (Amazon), Angkor E/W (Samsung SSIR, Wayfair), Apollo, Troy (Synopsys) and the new Memphis towers (Nvidia's 760,000 sq ft lease from April 2026).

techParks.name: Bagmane Rio Business Park
techParks.locality: Mahadevapura, Outer Ring Road (west of Bagmane WTC)
techParks.description: Bagmane's built-to-suit park beside the WTC campus; OpenStreetMap names its main building 'Google Ananta', the 1.6 msf, 5,000-seat campus Google inaugurated in February 2025 as its largest in India. The Bagmane REIT records Rio as a 1.1 msf asset (93% stake being acquired), so the 1.6 msf press figure likely includes space beyond the REIT's leasable area.

techParks.name: Bagmane Solarium City
techParks.locality: Kundalahalli Colony / Brookefield, at the ORR-Whitefield cusp (Doddanekundi)
techParks.description: 82-acre campus launched 2017 (3.8 msf completed, 1 msf under construction, 10.5 msf planned) with buildings named after noble gases: Neon-W, Xenon-N, Xenon-S, Argon-N, Helium and Radon. Schneider Electric's ~0.48 msf R&D centre (2023) and Cognizant, Baker Hughes and Carelon are its anchor tenants.

techParks.name: Prestige Technostar
techParks.locality: Doddanekundi Industrial Area 2, Phase 1, Brookefield (ITPL Main Road)
techParks.description: Prestige Group's ~8.5-acre, ~10.5 lakh sq ft office park on ITPL Main Road in the Doddanekundi Industrial Area, with B1-B3 blocks, food courts and The Executive Centre's serviced offices on Level 8 of B3. Tenant disclosure is thin; AMD, o9 Solutions and Netskope are mapped inside it on OSM.

techParks.name: Prestige Featherlite Tech Park
techParks.locality: Plot 148, EPIP Zone Phase 2, Whitefield Road (Kaveri Nagar / Doddanekundi side)
techParks.description: Small Prestige office building at Plot 148, EPIP Zone, Whitefield Road, opposite KTPO and beside Sattva's Mindcomp Tech Park, marketed largely as serviced/startup space (INR 14,000 per seat per month in one listing). No anchor tenant could be confirmed; OSM places Srijan Technologies inside it. Not to be confused with Prestige Featherlite Tech Hub in Kadubeesanahalli.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Mindcomp Tech Park
techParks.locality: EPIP Zone Phase 2, Whitefield Road (Kaveri Nagar / Doddanekundi side)
techParks.description: Completed Salarpuria Sattva office park ('Sattva Mindcomp Tech Park, Whitefield' on the developer's project list) on the EPIP Zone frontage of Whitefield Road, adjoining Prestige Featherlite Tech Park and the STT data centre. No tenant could be confirmed from a primary or press source; Microchip Technology's Plot 149-B office lies on its edge.

techParks.name: Brigade Metropolis
techParks.locality: Garudachar Palya, Mahadevapura (Whitefield Road / ITPL Main Road)
techParks.description: Brigade's 40-acre integrated township on Whitefield Road; its office component is Summit (Towers A/B, the B-9 building on ITPL Main Road) plus The Arcade retail-and-small-office block. Awfis runs a coworking centre there and Kapture CX is headquartered on the 11th floor; Capgemini, Volvo and EY offices are mapped on the Summit towers.

techParks.name: GR Tech Park
techParks.description: Completed Salarpuria Sattva office park listed as 'Sattva GR Tech Park, Whitefield'; Nominatim places it on Whitefield Road at Belathur (east of ITPB), i.e. outside the Mahadevapura cluster this lens expected. No tenant could be confirmed.

techParks.description: Shell's 52-acre, purpose-built R&D campus near Kempegowda International Airport, opened March 2017 for up to 1,500 scientists and engineers, consolidating Bengaluru teams previously spread across the city; one of Shell's three global technology hubs (with Amsterdam and Houston).

coverageNotes: WebSearch budget for the shared run was exhausted after ~12 queries, so most verification came from WebFetch of primary pages (Bagmane's Constellation/Capital/Solarium occupier pages, arm.com, aboutamazon.in, executivecentre.com, tataelxsi.com), lease news (Realty Today, Cyril Amarchand, Yahoo Finance, Equipment India, Electronics For You/HT via NAREDCO) and the OSM office POI and landuse extracts; OSM-only tenancies are marked low (medium only where the POI carries a street address, a named building or an official website). Could not confirm in this lens: Siemens, Walmart Global Tech (OSM puts Walmart Labs at Kadubeesanahalli), Juniper, Oracle, Nokia (OSM: Manyata), Intel (OSM: RMZ Ecospace/Sarjapur ORR), Sabre, Kyndryl and Zoho - no office of theirs was found in the Bagmane/Mahadevapura parks, so they are omitted rather than guessed. Infineon's reported ~6.3 lakh sq ft lease at 'Solarium City' appeared only in a search snippet that mis-named the developer and could not be fetched, so it is left out. Arm's older Citrine Block office in Bagmane WTC (still an OSM POI) is omitted because arm.com now lists only Taurus 4. Deloitte, Microsoft, BNP Paribas, Databricks and Visteon rest on a developer occupier list or a single press mention with no tower, and use park centroids. Nvidia's Memphis South office is recorded active on the strength of a lease effective 1 Apr 2026; fit-out/occupation was not verified. Google Ananta's park is taken from the OSM/Nominatim name 'Google Ananta, Bagmane Rio Business Park' plus press placing it in Mahadevapura built by Bagmane; the REIT's 1.1 msf figure for Rio does not match the 1.6 msf press figure, noted in the park description. Prestige Technopolis geocodes to S.G. Palya / Hosur Road (12.937, 77.608), far outside this lens, and GR Tech Park resolves to Whitefield Road at Belathur (east Whitefield), so both were treated as not part of the Mahadevapura cluster (GR Tech Park is listed with no tenants). Tenants of Prestige Featherlite Tech Park and Sattva Mindcomp Tech Park could not be confirmed from any primary or press source (operator pages returned 403/empty). Deliberately left to neighbouring lenses although visible in the OSM extract: Brigade Tech Gardens (Mercedes-Benz R&D, JLR, Aptiv), Kalyani Platina (HPE, Byju's, Delphi), the EPIP/ITPL Whitefield campuses (Capgemini, Accenture, Intel ITPL Rd, Tesco, Huawei, Hindustan Unilever, ExxonMobil, Applied Materials, Texas Instruments) and Brigade Nalapad Centre (McKinsey, Flipkart, Quantiphi, Airbus POIs - OSM only). Capgemini EPIP, AMD EPIP, GE JFWTC, Qualcomm EPIP and Tata Elxsi Whitefield are included only because the same companies also have offices inside this lens. No PSU other than HAL's ARDC was found in the lens; Airports Authority of India has an office in Doddanekundi (OSM) but its function could not be confirmed.
